name: breastcalculator
description: Breast Calculator — static site deployed to Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-tailwind.js && node scripts/purgecss.js && node scripts/build-css.js && node scripts/split-script.js && node scripts/reflow-fix.js && node scripts/idle-schedule.js && node scripts/dom-reduce.js && node scripts/layout-normalize.js && node scripts/optimize.js && node scripts/perf-fixes.js && node scripts/cache-bust.js && node scripts/build-dist.js && echo 'Static site ready in dist/.'
scripts.dev: echo 'Open index.html in a browser, or run: npx http-server -p 8000'
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env preview
